description: Synthetic telemetry for Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines Hardcoded Credential Exploitation

events.event_name: Use hardcoded credential for remote access

data.description: Attacker uses the hardcoded credential (CVE-2026-22769) to access a network-reachable RecoverPoint for VMs appliance.
Attacker reaches the underlying OS and executes commands as a privileged user.
Attacker establishes root-level persistence; GRIMBOLT/BRICKSTORM backdoors reported. (T1543 enabled only if local validation confirms service creation — behavioral.)
Attacker uses remote services to move into connected VMware virtual infrastructure.

events.event_name: Detect root access without maintenance ticket

data.description: Blue team alerts on RecoverPoint access from an unapproved identity path and root sessions without a corresponding maintenance ticket.
SOC blocks untrusted access, applies the fixed release / remediation script, treats root access as an integrity failure and rebuilds as appropriate.

expected_matches.description: RecoverPoint access from unapproved identity path
RecoverPoint root session without maintenance ticket
RecoverPoint appliance connecting to VMware management
